GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.5 (12 Aug 46) GB/CIS
(SCAPIN-1123)
APO 500
12 August 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Apprehension of Chinese Nationals.
1. The Imperial Japanese Government will immediately apprehend and deliver to the Commandant, Sugamo Prison, for incarceration, the following persons, formerly Chinese puppet government officials;
KANG, Shan-huang
Medical Officer,
Chinese Embassy, Tokyo
BAU, Chi-Kang
Acting Maneger,
Tokyo Office, Central Reserve Bank of Nanking puppet government
CHEN, Shan-tung
Asst Secretary,
Naval Attache's Office, puppet Chinese Embassy, Tokyo
TING, Chiu-chang
(Lt) Clerk,
Military Attache's Office, puppet Chinese Embassy in Tokyo.
2. The Imperial Japanese Government will advise this headquarters when the above individuals have been delivered to the authorities of Sugamo Prison. In the event the Japanese Government is unable to make delivery of any of these individuals by 2400 hours, 25 August 1946, it will make a report in detail giving the present location of the individual not arrested, and the reason for failure to arrest.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
